headline: A 2019 executive order directs federal agencies to update how they regulate farm products made with biotechnology.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to modernize the rules that cover agricultural biotechnology products, such as crops or animals changed using genetic engineering. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, deadlines, and agencies involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Companies and researchers that develop agricultural biotechnology products
who_it_affects.how: The rules they follow to bring these products to market may be changed.

who_it_affects.group: Farmers who grow or raise biotech crops or animals
who_it_affects.how: The products available to them and the rules around those products may be affected by updated regulations.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that oversee farm and food products
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to review and update how they regulate agricultural biotechnology.

when_it_takes_effect: Executive orders generally take effect when signed, which was June 11, 2019.
